observations.start: Ivy Sophista at 2907,3450,0 in Taverley. Quest Helper requires 180 QP, ten completed quests, six nonboostable skills and Warriors’ Guild access.
observations.requirements: 72 Thieving, 67 Magic, 66 Agility, 65 Herblore, 65 Farming and 62 Hunter, plus ten direct quests. Warriors’ Guild access requires 130 combined base Attack and Strength, or 99 in either. The catalog enumerates all valid minimum pairs.
observations.chapters: Ivy and Thaerisk; broav tracking and Movario’s basement/library; mercenary ambush and the secret order; suspect scrying orb, pink lens and enriched snapdragon; Slayer-master contacts and Warriors’ Guild recruitment; prisoner sketch, Black Knights’ catacombs, Silif and Surok; Squall disguise, chapel and Chasm of Tears; elemental braziers/block cavities, druid pouch, Balance Elemental, Stone of Jas and Tormented Demons.
observations.supplies: The launderer accepts 500 coins or the activated Ring of Charos. Pink dye costs 20 coins. A fixed 5,000 GP GE estimate covers runes, the unpowered orb, bronze med helm, iron chainbody and other traded tools. Reuse the lit sapphire lantern from Tears of Guthix and collect the law and death runes in the hideout.
observations.completion: 5 quest points; 80,000 Thieving, 75,000 Farming, 75,000 Herblore and 50,000 Hunter XP, awarded exactly once on the completion action; Tormented Demon access unlock.
observations.claim: Post-quest Kuradal in Shilo Village provides Duradel’s notes. Reading consumes the book, immediately awards 15 XP per current Slayer level through the existing level-based reward table, and unlocks demonbane crafting.
